messages:
Noah Kim: Quick sync  We're green for the benchmark blog + launch note Friday 09:00 PT. Need final press list, CEO quote, and a reactive line.
Ava Martinez: On press list. Adding two embargoed analyst contacts; sharing in the drive. Who's on press duty at publish?
Riley Scott: I'll cover press@ and my DMs 08:4510:15 PT. Can someone prep a short reactive Q&A for tight turnaround?
Noah Kim: Good. Riley on press. Ava on social. I need a 15-word CEO line that avoids superlatives. Legal flagged one phrase.
LegalBot: Legal note: replace "industry-leading" with "significant" and remove hard customer counts. Also add a line offering methodology on request.
Ava Martinez: Draft CEO: "These benchmarks show meaningful reductions in latency and cost on representative LLM workloads." Short and neutral.
Riley Scott: Solid. Draft reactive Q: "Our internal benchmarks reflect typical customer workloads; full methodology is available on publish." Will post DM-ready and a longer FAQ.
Noah Kim: Please also prepare a short embargo-friendly summary for syndication partners (one paragraph, no numbers).
Ava Martinez: Drafted partner summary and placed in PR drive: https://drive.redwood/launch/partner-summary-v1 (watermarked).
press-bot: Embargo set: 2025-07-17T09:00:00Z. Auto-hold enabled for scheduled socials.
Riley Scott: Flag  one outlet asked for a preview clip for a morning show. Legal says no early clips. I'll offer the reactive Q and the methodology on publish.
Noah Kim: Ops: we'll use #press-watch during the hour. If any embargo break, escalate immediately to @exec-comm and call Legal.
Ava Martinez: Social plan: initial X + LinkedIn at publish, engineer thread 30m later, and an explainer short-form clip 1h later. Need final hero stills from design by EOD.
Riley Scott: Also prepping a short internal TL;DR for sales and support to send after publish. No raw numbers in partner channels.
LegalBot: Confirmed wording for all outward-facing copy: avoid absolute comparisons, use "multiple customers" or "early adopters" if needed.
Noah Kim: Final ops: we'll do a 09:30 PT check-in in this thread. If no objections by 20:00 PT today, proceed with publish. :white_check_mark:
